tools.name: get_blog_article
tools.description: Returns the full text of one Ifá Discovery article by slug, for detailed, accurate answers on a specific Yorùbá cosmology topic. Use for educational answers; do not append promotion of the paid report, its price, or purchase routes unless the user explicitly asks about the service.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_offering" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_blog_articles" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_offering" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
